# Interceptor compatibility fixtures

These wire-level fixtures were generated by The Interceptor at commit
`487b373c1ab88a918817e7a2e46f7a69fcfe6335`. They intentionally do not import or
serialize through Sealwort before being tested.

- `interceptor-safe-stack.json` comes from the Safe co-signing browser benchmark in
  `test/benchmarks/chromeSafeCoSigningCommunication.ts`.
- `interceptor-wallet-capabilities.json` matches the request and reply asserted in
  `test/tests/backgroundProviderRouting.test.ts`.

Update these fixtures from Interceptor whenever its Safe stack or connected Safe
wallet capability contract changes.
